title: Governed protected Managed Execution canary infrastructure

phases.objective: Add a merge-blocked, secret-safe mechanism that can execute a protected Tenant Managed Execution canary only after the runner is part of trusted main, without executing the live canary from pull-request code.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository owner preparing a separately authorized protected-runtime canary
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Canonical npm test manifest plus issue-comment workflow contract
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The repository rejects any canary implementation that can checkout PR-head code with the admin secret, use a long-lived tenant JWT, target an untrusted runtime host, execute provider/deployment/migration/SQL effects, or apply reconciliation; the live canary remains intentionally unexecuted until these files are merged into trusted main.
steps: Load the protected canary runner and workflow as source contracts.
Require the workflow to use issue_comment with the authorized repository owner identity and exact main/Production SHAs.
Require checkout of the exact trusted main SHA with persisted Git credentials disabled.
Require the existing admin-governed Platform JWT client to mint a 600-second tenant token after active user and membership validation.
Require an explicit user, tenant, parent ticket, capability, resource type, and resource reference fixture.
Require a cross-tenant negative probe, tenant-safe projection, admin projection, idempotency, retry, reassignment, approval, rollback, and dry-run reconciliation assertions in the live runner.
Reject provider, connector, direct SQL, migration, deployment, and reconciliation-Apply surfaces in the runner.
Register the static safety test in the canonical npm test manifest.
Keep the live protected canary and Production runtime readback as post-merge evidence rather than claiming them from synthetic tests.
assertions: The workflow cannot expose BACKEND_API_KEY to code checked out from a pull-request head.
The workflow verifies exact current main and protected Production refs before and after the live canary.
The runner obtains a short-lived tenant-compatible token from /auth/platform-jwt/issue and does not store a long-lived USER_JWT.
Tenant-path assertions do not fall back to admin identity.
The runner performs no provider dispatch, external business send, direct SQL, Migration Apply, deployment/restart/release activation, or reconciliation Apply.
The merge-blocking test is part of the canonical npm test manifest.
This PR does not claim canary or production phase completion and does not itself execute the protected runtime canary.
